summary: Logan County, WV tower on Mud Fork mountain; a 1932 newspaper item reports progress on it; registered 2017 as US 1673, WV 64 and listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by FireLookout.org; no removal date, cause or remains are described by any source read

events.note: Charleston Gazette item reports progress on the Cabin Hill forest fire tower on Mud Fork mountain (September 1932)
Registered January 26, 2017, nominated by Brian M. Powell

evidence.supports: 1932 report of progress on the Cabin Hill tower on Mud Fork mountain
evidence.quote: Mr. Griffin advised the commission that progress is being made on the Cabin Hill forest fire tower on Mud Fork mountain, Logan county.

evidence.supports: 1932 item says nearly twenty counties and part of eastern Kentucky are visible from the tower
evidence.quote: Almost a score of counties and a large section of eastern Kentucky are visible from the tower.

evidence.supports: register names the administering agency (spelled with an extra s in the register)
the 1932 page names the agency as the West Virginia Conservation Commission
FireLookout.org lists the Cabin Hill tower as gone
evidence.quote: Cabin Hill Logan 37.84909 -82.08864 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1673, WV 64

corrections.why: Spelling error (extra s) in the FFLOS register and in our record copied from it; the 1932 Forest Lookouts page names the West Virginia Conservation Commission.

notes_for_editor: Only the 1932 Gazette item (Forest Lookouts page), the FFLOS register entry and the FireLookout.org list describe this site. No build date, builder, staffing or removal date found. A WebSearch returned a Blair Mountain tower in Logan County; that is a different site and was not used. The state tower list PDF (wvenc-f5.wvnet.edu) could not be reached (DNS failure) and may hold more history. The WVU photo catalog entries returned 403.
